source: 782 Clamor
target: 782 Clamor

source: Banamo Port, Carnival Bar.
target: Banamo Port, Carnival Bar.

source: Adventurer Mason had donned the loose pants and thick jacket favored by pirates.
target: Peragrator Mason bracas laxas et cassidum crassum, a piratis gratissimum, induerat.

source: He looked toward the unknown adventurer drinking strong liquor with his back to him, feeling a constant tension.
target: Ad peragratorem ignotum, qui potum fortem lugubri saepe bibebat et tergum ad se habebat, intuebatur, dum constanti angore affectus esset.

source: He wasn’t worried about being hurt but was anxious about when this kind of life would end.
target: Non de laesione sollicitus erat sed de tempore quo talis vita finem haberet anxius versabatur.

source: Pirates were never reasonable; they would always vent their anger on others.
target: Piratae numquam rationem habebant; iram suam in alios semper effuderent.

source: After no one stepped up to respond to the arrogant unknown adventurer, many pirates tried to take their anger out on other adventurers in Banamo Port.
target: Quod nemo ad peragratorem arroganti ignotum conversum contendere animadvertit, multi piratae in ceteros peragratores in Banamo Port iram suam dirigere conati sunt.

source: Frequent adventurers in Banamo Port were used to a life of hiding.
target: Peragratores cotidiani in Banamo Port vitam abscondendi soliti erant.

source: They would never openly identify as adventurers, disguising themselves as other professions instead.
target: Numquam manifeste se peragratores agnoscerent, sed se aliis officiis celare solebant.

source: Otherwise, bodies would be found in alleys or floating near the docks.
target: Alioquin corpora in angulis aut prope pontificia fluctuantia reperirentur.

source: In this pirate-dominated port, being an adventurer was clearly a dangerous and elusive profession.
target: In hoc portu, a piratis dominato, esse peragratorem manifeste officium periculosum et elusivum videbatur.

source: People like Mason had regular identities to disguise themselves, sometimes even joining pirate crews to help gather supplies while stationed in Banamo Port.
target: Homines ut Mason identitates communes habebant ad se celandum, interdum etiam classibus piratarum iungendo ad opes colligendas dum in Banamo Port manebant.

source: Taking on commissions wouldn’t expose an adventurer’s identity because many pirates also took jobs for rewards.
target: Mandata accipere identitatem peragratoris detegere non poterat, quoniam multi piratae negotia pro praemiis susceperunt.

source: For example, if they killed a rival pirate, they could collect a bounty through connections.
target: Exempli causa, si piratam adversarium occiderent, per coniunctiones praemium colligere poterant.

source: Who wouldn’t want that?
target: Quis id non velle posset?

source: Pirates approached tasks differently from adventurers.
target: Piratae negotia aliter aggrediebantur quam peragratores.

source: They would first identify the mission issuer and decide if they could kill the client directly.
target: Primo emissarium missionis agnoscebant atque statuere conabantur num cliente directe interfici posse.

source: Some adventurers would naturally turn into bandits in lawless areas.
target: Nonnulli peragratores in regionibus iniquis naturaliter ad latrones redire solebant.

source: Mason had recently lost his job at a trading company.
target: Mason nuper officium suum in societate mercatoria amiserat.

source: With his distinct, non-native features, he had to dress as a pirate to avoid trouble.
target: Cum lineis distinctis et extraneis, ut pirata se indueret, ne in commotionem incidens necesse habebat.

source: His thoughts drifted to a corner of the Carnival Bar near the window.
target: Cogitationes eius ad angulum Carnival Bar iuxta fenestram vagabantur.

source: The walls were charred, the glass cracked, and overturned tables and chairs lay amidst two charred bodies that had been burning for a long time.
target: Muri decocti erant, vitrum fractum, et mensae ac cathedrae revolutae inter duas corpora exustas, diu ardentia, iacebant.

source: These were two pirates.
target: Hi erant duo piratae.

source: Earlier that afternoon, they had recognized an adventurer they had encountered before and decided to vent their malice on him.
target: Ante meridiem illa, peragratorem quem olim occurrerant agnoverunt atque decreverunt in eum malitiam suam effundere.

source: The unknown adventurer at the bar counter didn’t even turn his head, summoning one fiery raven after another, blasting the pirates apart and burning them.
target: Peragrator ignotus ad mensam tabernarii quidem quidem caput vertit, sed non sufficiens; unus post alium corvi igniti evocati sunt, qui piratas dissipaverunt atque combusserunt.

source: This convinced the watching pirates that the unknown adventurer was a man of his word.
target: Hoc piratis spectantibus convincit peragratorem ignotum virum veri dicti esse.

source: If he said he would kill, he would kill.
target: Si dixerit interficere se, interficeret.

source: If he promised punishment for crossing the line, there would be punishment, even in a pirate port watched by thousands of pirates and many Beyonders.
target: Si poenam pro transgressione promissit, poena dabitur, etiam in portu piratarum ab milibus et multis Beyonder inspexum.

source: And the pirates’ captain didn’t dare retaliate.
target: Et dux piratarum non ausus est refellere.

source: Mason had witnessed the entire scene.
target: Mason totum spectaculum conspectum habebat.

source: He noticed that the two pirates were familiar with the Pyromaniac’s abilities and were quite skilled, with one being a Low-Sequence Beyonder.
target: Animadvertit duo piratas potentiam Pyromaniaci bene novisse et peritissimos esse, quorum unus Beyonder ordinis humilis erat.

source: Despite their precautions, they couldn’t escape the ravens.
target: Quamquam cautiones ceperant, corvis effugere non poterant.

source: They were covered in flames by the window before they could escape from the center of the bar.
target: Flammis iuxta fenestram tegeri eos antequam e media taberna evaderent.

source: This filled Mason with admiration and longing.
target: Hoc Mason admiratione ac desiderio implevit.

source: When will I have such power?
target: Quando talis vis mihi futura erit?

source: When can I become an adventurer who can intimidate so many pirates?
target: Quando peragrator fieri possum qui tantos piratas terret?

source: Mason had intended to “kindly” help the pirates deal with the bodies, but to his regret, their captain and first mate quickly arrived and collected their “inheritance.”
target: Mason commerte auxilium ferre intendebat piratis ad corpora tractanda, sed ad illum dolorem, dux piratarum primusque nauta celeriter accesserunt et suam “portionem” collegissent.

source: I should stick close to this adventurer.
target: Adhaerebo huic peragratore.

source: If I’m recognized, I’m done for…
target: Si agnoscarer, perditionem patiibo…

source: Mason muttered, gulping down his dark beer.
target: Mason murmuravit dum obscuram cerevisiam vorax edebat.

source: How did my life change so drastically?
target: Quomodo vita mea tam drastice mutata est?

source: Though he hadn’t been harmed, he felt implicated.
target: Quamquam non laesus erat, se implicatum sentiebat.

source: This heightened his fear that he might have brought disaster to Banamo Port, though it didn’t seem like a disaster yet.
target: Hoc metum eius auxit, ne Banamo Port cladem intulisset, quamquam clades nondum videbatur.

source: He hoped it would end when the unknown adventurer left or a Pirate Admiral or King arrived.
target: Spem habebat finem futurum esse cum peragrator ignotus discessisset aut Admiralis Piratarum vel Rex advenerit.

source: Never perform rituals you don’t fully understand… Mason warned himself.
target: Numquam ritus quos non penitus intellegis exsequere… Mason sibi ipsi monuit.

source: He then raised his glass to his reflection on the wall, toasting to his resolution.
target: Deinde poculum ad imaginem in pariete tollens, pro sua resolutione convivium fecit.

source: In the shadow, Franca was intently observing the Carnival Bar inside and out.
target: In umbra, Franca diligenter Carnival Bar ex interioribus et exterioribus partibus observabat.

source: This was her task.
target: Hoc erat munus illius.

source: Even though Lumian was vigilant and prepared, he could still be ambushed.
target: Quamquam Lumian vigilans et paratus erat, tamen insidiari poterat.

source: The Beyonder world had many strange, unpredictable, and hard-to-defend abilities, rituals, and spells.
target: Mundus Beyonder multae habebat insolitae, incognitae atque difficillime defendendae virtutes, ritus, et incantationes.

source: Thus, Franca stayed hidden, monitoring the surroundings from another angle, ready to intervene or provide a Mirror Substitution.
target: Ita Franca latuit, ex alio angulo circumiecta perscrutans, parata intervenire aut substitutionem speculi praebere.

source: In the past few days of wandering around Banamo Port with Lumian, Franca had seen pirates drinking, chatting, joking, eating, gambling, venting, and sleeping, making them seem no different from ordinary people.
target: His paucis diebus in Banamo Port cum Lumian errans, Franca piratas bibentes, colloquentes, iocantes, edentes, aleam ludentes, iram effundentes et dormientes vidit, ita ut ab vulgari hominibus non distinguerentur.

source: She felt a bit guilty about the possible plague plan.
target: Aliquantum se culpam habere sensit de consilio pestilentiae possibile.

source: But after witnessing pirate battles and hearing about killings, kidnappings, bullying, robbery, and rape, she genuinely felt that letting these scum die from the plague would purify the world and be a good deed.
target: Sed postquam pugnas piratarum viderat atque de caedibus, rapinis, vexationibus, furtis, et stupri audiverat, vere sensit ut hos spurcissimos pestilentia interfectos mundum purificaret et bonum factum foret.

source: Ignoring her hunger, Franca grumbled about Lumian, “This guy, doesn’t he know it’s been an hour past lunch?”
target: Fame neglegens, Franca de Lumiano murmurat: “Hic homo, num non novit iam unam horam post prandium transisse?”

source: You get to eat, but I don’t!
target: “Tu cibum accipis, ego vero non!”

source: Based on our previous understanding, shouldn’t we shake off potential trackers, hide back at the inn, and let me rest and eat something?
target: “Ex nostro consensu nonne debemus vestigia potentialium vestigiatorum abicere, reverti ad deversorium, atque mihi concedere tempus ad requiem et ad cibandum?”

source: Despite her complaints, Franca continued to dutifully monitor the surroundings.
target: Non obstante querelis, Franca diligenter circumiecta perscrutari continuavit.

source: At that moment, a few pirates entered, bringing a lively, joyful, and excited atmosphere to different tables.
target: Illo momento, pauci piratae intraverunt, diversis mensis animosam, laetam et excitatam atmosphaeram afferentes.

source: Hmm… Franca melded into the shadows, sticking to the wall, and stealthily approached a group of pirates to listen in.
target: Hmm… Franca in umbras se contulit, ad parietem adhaerens, et caute ad coetum piratarum accessit ut auscultaret.

source: “Admiral Deep Sea is really here?”
target: “Admiralis Profundae Maris vere hic est?”

source: “The Newins has already docked!”
target: “Newins iam in portu positus est!”

source: “Do they know about the adventurer?”
target: “Num de peragratore sciunt?”

source: Oh, Admiral Deep Sea is finally here… Franca silently confirmed with a guess.
target: O, Admiralis Profundae Maris demum hic est… Franca tacite coniectura confirmavit.

source: Since Jenna hadn’t issued a warning, it meant no Pirate King had arrived in Banamo Port.
target: Quia Jenna monitionem non emisisset, id significabat nullum Regem Piratarum in Banamo Port accessisse.

source: Franca began to anticipate Admiral Deep Sea’s reaction and actions.
target: Franca coepit exspectare responsionem atque actiones Admiralis Profundae Maris.

source: She was sure Admiral Deep Sea and his key subordinates were aware of the unknown adventurer’s provocation.
target: Certa erat Admiralem Profundae Maris et eius principales subordinatos de provo catio peragratoris ignoti instructos esse.

source: It was a simple deduction.
target: Erat simplex coniectura.

source: Since Admiral Deep Sea was avoiding the King of Dusk, he would first confirm the situation in Banamo Port before coming to resupply.
target: Quia Admiralis Profundae Maris Regem Crepusculi vitabat, primum condicionem in Banamo Port confirmaret antequam supplementa petere veniret.

source: The common practice was to send lesser-known pirates from the fleet on other ships to scout Banamo Port.
target: Consuetudo communis erat piratas minus notos ex classe in aliis navibus mittere ut Banamo Port explorerent.

source: If Banamo Port was a regular stop, trusted subordinates might be stationed there long-term, reporting back promptly.
target: Si Banamo Port statio regularis esset, fideles subordinati ibi diuturno tempore colloci poterant et celeriter referre.

source: Of course, local forces could also provide warnings.
target: Scilicet copiae locales etiam monitiones praebere poterant.

source: In any case, Admiral Deep Sea would be well aware of recent events in Banamo Port; otherwise, he wouldn’t surface the Newins.
target: Quacumque causa, Admiralis Profundae Maris recentes res in Banamo Port bene sciret; alioquin, Newins non appareret.

source: Franca calmed herself, no longer distracted by hunger.
target: Franca se tranquillavit, fame non amplius perturbata.

source: But like the pirates, she waited half an hour without seeing Admiral Deep Sea or his key subordinates, growing puzzled.
target: Sed sicut piratae, dimidiam horam exspectavit, neque Admiralem Profundae Maris neque eius duchos videns, consternata.

source: Why haven’t they shown up?
target: Cur non apparuerunt?

source: Could it be that Admiral Deep Sea is also a cautious person?
target: Num Admiralis Profundae Maris etiam cautus sit?

source: But Lumian is only showing the strength of a strong Sequence 6.
target: Sed Lumian tantum vim validi Ordinis VI ostendit.

source: This crafty guy is using crimson-white flames, not the Reaper’s white flames…
target: Hic callidus vir utitur flammis rubro–albis, non flammas albas Messoris…

source: Franca thought carefully and understood the reason.
target: Franca diligenter cogitavit et causam intellexit.

source: If she were in his shoes, targeted by the King of Dusk, she wouldn’t cause trouble right after arriving at a port.
target: Si in eius loco esset, a Rege Crepusculi subiecta, non statim tumultum efferreret postquam portum advenisset.

source: She would complete the resupply first and prepare for another dive.
target: Primum supplementa absolveret et ad aliam inmersionem praepararet.

source: That way, even if something unexpected happened, they could leave Banamo Port immediately and not complete their primary objective here.
target: Ita, si quid inopinatum eveniret, statim Banamo Port relinquere poterent neque hic proprium propositum perficerent.

source: Also, Lumian, the unknown adventurer, had been in Banamo Port for two or three days.
target: Etiam Lumian, peragrator ignotus, duos vel tres dies in Banamo Port versatus erat.

source: He didn’t seem to be hunting bounties of lesser known pirates, as if he were waiting for something.
target: Non videbatur praedas piratarum minus notarum insequi, quasi aliquid exspectaret.

source: This could make people suspicious of his true intentions.
target: Hoc efficit ut homines de eius veris propositis suspicionem habeant.

source: Admiral Deep Sea would naturally be cautious.
target: Naturali modo, Admiralis Profundae Maris cautus esset.

source: Phew… Franca sighed silently.
target: Fuf… Franca tacite suspiravit.

source: Her gaze continued to sweep across the Carnival Bar, wary of any surprises.
target: Aspectus eius per Carnival Bar percurrit, cautus ulla miracula vitans.

source: In the process, her eyes inevitably swept over Lumian, noticing her companion’s slight smile and good mood, holding a cup of amber-colored Lanti Proof mixed with something unknown.
target: Interea oculi eius inevitabiliter super Lumian percurrerunt, animadvertentes levem risum et bonum animum comitis, qui poculum Lanti Proof coloris ambrae cum aliquo incognito mixtum tenebat.

source: Lumian played with his glass, using his Hunter’s exceptional hearing to roughly understand why the pirates were suddenly excited and anxious.
target: Lumian poculo luderat, eximio auditu venatoris utens, ut approximanter intelligeret cur piratae subito excitati et anxii essent.

source: His target had arrived!
target: Meta eius advenit!

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised since he already knew—Jenna had come by earlier and left a note under his hand, concealed by shadows.
target: Lumian non stupefactus erat, nam iam sciebat—Jenna prius accessisse et sub manu eius notam relinqueret, umbris occultatam.

source: Knowing Admiral Deep Sea wouldn’t come looking for him immediately, Lumian remained calm, acting unaware of the commotion behind him.
target: Sciens Admiralem Profundae Maris non statim eum quaeriturum esse, Lumian quies servabat, se inscius tumultus post eum agens.

source: He glanced at the bartender trying to control his expression and smiled.
target: Ille ad tabernarium, qui vultum suum temperare conabatur, brevem intuerebat, et subridens effexit.

source: “The wind is quite noisy today,” Lumian said.
target: “Vento hodie satis strepituoso est,” inquit Lumian.

source: The bartender didn’t know how to respond, forcing a stiff smile.
target: Tabernarius nescivit quomodo respondeat, coactus tamen subridere firmum.

source: “True.”
target: “Vere.”

source: Lumian said nothing more, feeling his emotions and state change.
target: Lumian nihil amplius dixit, sentiens motus atque statum suum mutari.

source: To be honest, he felt a bit nervous about facing a Pirate Admiral with his fleet.
target: Ad veritatem, paulum anxius se sensit ob congressum cum Admirali Piratarum cum classe sua.

source: But it also made his blood boil slightly.
target: Sed etiam sanguinem suum leviter ebullire fecit.

source: He had never been one to shy away from challenges.
target: Numquam fuit qui a provocationibus recederet.

source: Since becoming a Hunter, he had tasted the allure of challenges even more.
target: Ex quo Venator factus est, allicitatem provocationum etiam magis gustaverat.

source: With that thought, Lumian raised his cup of Lumian to his lips, tilted his head back, and drank it all in one go.
target: Hoc cogitans, Lumian poculum suum ad labra attulit, caput retrorsum inclinavit, et totum in uno hausto biberat.
